statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-16118 is a 2-byte heap out-of-bounds write in GLib's bundled xdgmime code, in _xdg_mime_magic_parse_magic_line() in xdgmimemagic.c, reached when an application doing MIME type detection parses an attacker-controlled MIME magic file in a user-writable XDG data directory. Debian fixed it for trixie in glib2.0 2.84.4-3~deb13u5 with patches from upstream GLib 2.89.x: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-16118, https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=1142717, https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/work_items/3992. The fixed version is this owner's first rebuild of Debian's 2.84.4-3~deb13u5: the Debian changelog shipped in its libglib2.0-0t64 package on amd64 and arm64 records the CVE-2026-16118 xdgmimemagic.c fix, as do the two later rebuilds of 2.84.4-3~deb13u5. The three published rebuilds of Debian's 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 do not carry the fix (their shipped changelog has no CVE-2026-16118 entry) and sort below the fixed version, so they are affected.
